nodes.title: tags
widgets_values:
## Fine-Grained Inline Control

S2 Pro lets you control speech by adding natural-language instructions directly in the text with **[tag]** syntax.

Unlike a fixed tag system, it supports free-form prompts such as  
[whisper in small voice] [professional broadcast tone] [pitch up]

This allows more precise control over tone, emotion, pacing, and delivery.

## Common tags
**15,000+ unique tags supported**

[pause] [emphasis] [laughing] [inhale] [chuckle] [tsk] [singing] [excited] [laughing tone] [interrupting] [chuckling] [excited tone] [volume up] [echo] [angry] [low volume] [sigh] [low voice] [whisper] [screaming] [shouting] [loud] [surprised] [short pause] [exhale] [delight] [panting] [audience laughter] [with strong accent] [volume down] [clearing throat] [sad] [moaning] [shocked]

## More info
[Read more on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/fishaudio/s2-pro)

nodes.title: Instructions
widgets_values:
**Models auto-download on first run**  
No manual setup needed.

Select the model you want in Fish S2 TTS node -> **model_path**.

## Default model: s2-pro-fp8
Requires about **20 GB VRAM**

| Model | VRAM | Size |
|---|---:|---:|
| s2-pro (bf16) | ~24 GB | ~10 GB |
| s2-pro-fp8 | ~20 GB | ~8 GB |
| s2-pro-BNB-int8 | ~20 GB | ~10 GB |
| s2-pro-BNB-nf4 | ~16 GB | ~10 GB |

## Manual download

Download **all files** for the selected model.

| Model | Size | Download | Path |
|---|---:|---|---|
| s2-pro (bf16) | ~10 GB | [Open files](https://huggingface.co/fishaudio/s2-pro/tree/main) | `ComfyUI\models\fishaudioS2\s2-pro` |
| s2-pro-fp8 | ~8 GB | [Open files](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/s2-pro-fp8/tree/main) | `ComfyUI\models\fishaudioS2\s2-pro-fp8` |
